tooltip.adrenaline.config.generation_thr: Maximum workers used to generate new terrain. Auto leaves CPU capacity for the rest of the game. This is a limit; adaptive workers may use fewer.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.adaptive_gener: Minimum workers kept when CPU usage exceeds 90% or server ticks exceed 50 ms: 1 worker or a percentage of the configured maximum, rounded up. Workers recover as load drops. Off disables adjustment.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.serialization_: Maximum workers used to encode chunk saves when Parallel chunk encoding is enabled. Auto chooses a limit based on available CPU threads.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.spawn_zone_rad: Area prepared around spawn before entering a new world. The saved value is a radius; radius 11 prepares 21 × 21 chunks. Smaller areas load sooner but prepare less terrain.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallel_world: Generates chunks using multiple workers. Independent of the individual terrain and biome optimizations in Advanced.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.stage_priority: Selects queued worldgen jobs by insertion order, highest chunk stage, or proximity to the player.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.save_chunks_af: Queues a final save for completed chunks when initial spawn generation finishes.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.incremental_sa: Saves completed spawn chunks after this many additional chunks are generated. Smaller intervals distribute saving more evenly.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.skip_saving_sc: Returns to the menu while the integrated server finishes saving in the background.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.terrain_fill_o: Speeds up block filling during terrain generation. The section batching path also needs Noise Chunk Optimizations and Native Aquifer Batching; other worlds retain the compatible block filling path.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_optimi: Compiles Java surface rules for faster evaluation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.noise_chunk_op: Batches updates to interpolated density coordinates.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.material_rule_: Reduces overhead in material rule dispatch.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.aquifer_optimi: Reduces aquifer lookup and fluid decision cost.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.beardifier_opt: Speeds up structure terrain blending calculations.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.ore_vein_optim: Speeds up ore vein sampling during generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.initial_spawn_: Uses a faster search for a suitable starting position while retaining the normal spawn suitability checks.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.feature_safety: Reserves nearby chunks while placing features. Increase for mods whose features extend farther than adjacent chunks. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.stage_parallel: Controls whether the %s stage is redirected to Adrenaline's parallel scheduler.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.fast_legacy_ra: Replaces legacy random with a faster implementation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.native_perlin_: Batches Perlin sampling through native code. This requires a bundled native library for your platform.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.approximate_na: Uses an experimental float-native Perlin backend inspired by QuickNoise. It changes terrain and is intended only for performance experiments.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.native_density: Compiles supported density graphs into a native cell evaluator. Unsupported graphs keep using the JVM.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.native_aquifer: Evaluates supported vanilla aquifer material cells through native code. It falls back when a mod supplies unsupported fluid states.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.show_cancel_bu: Shows the cancel button during initial world generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.show_chunk_pre: Replaces completed chunk squares with a top-down terrain preview during initial world generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.show_thread_vi: Shows generation worker activity during initial world generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.warmup_on_star: Prepares world generation once per game launch. Wait at startup finishes before the main menu; Background lets you use the menu while it works; Off skips warmup. Changes apply next launch.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.prepare_world_: Prepares and reuses a clean Create World context to avoid repeated datapack loading.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.fast_terrain_l: Off keeps normal world entry. On enters once the first chunk arrives when reopening worlds. Extreme skips the Loading Terrain wait immediately.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.start_beforeha: Shows a button that enters the world after the first full chunk is ready.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.worldgen_bench: Measures world creation from start until the configured spawn zone is ready, then compares the same random-seed 11x11 block sample. Available from menus only.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.debug_logging: Logs extra Adrenaline diagnostics to the console.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.force_easter_e: Shows the April Fools animation during new world creation.
gui.adrenaline.config.native_unavailable: Native backend unavailable in this session.
gui.adrenaline.config.requires_exact_noi: Inactive while Approximate Float Perlin is enabled.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.biome_search_o: Indexes compatible climate parameter lists by column to avoid repeating the full biome search. Unsupported lists use the original search.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.biome_climate_: Caches height-independent temperature and humidity samples across a column during biome generation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.biome_fiddle_o: Caches repeated biome position calculations. Also helps biome conditions used by surface rules.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.density_mappin: Reuses density graph nodes while constructing noise and climate samplers. Independent of noise sampling optimizations.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_noise_: Batches and reuses surface depth noise samples. Independent of surface rule compilation. Requires exact noise; approximation disables this path temporarily.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_column: Buffers compatible surface block columns and commits changes by section. Modded storage hooks keep their original block access.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.native_surface: Compiles supported surface rules into native programs evaluated by column. Unsupported rules keep their original behavior. Requires the native backend.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.blending_optim: Avoids unnecessary blending work when chunks have no old terrain to blend with.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.heightmap_opti: Avoids updating unmodified vanilla heightmaps when a block write does not change the block state.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallel_chunk: Encodes chunk saves on separate workers. The resulting world files use the normal Minecraft format.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.palette_packin: Packs compatible block palettes directly when encoding chunks, reducing allocations during saves.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.shape_cache_op: Uses a bounded shape cache per thread to reduce contention during full-block shape checks.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_st: Allows the Structure Starts stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
Allows the Structure References stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_bi: Allows the Biomes stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_no: Allows the Noise stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_su: Allows the Surface stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_ca: Allows the Carvers stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_fe: Allows the Features stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_in: Allows the Initialize Light stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_li: Allows the Light stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_sp: Allows the Spawn stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.parallelize_fu: Allows the Full stage to run on Adrenaline workers. Turn off to keep this stage on its original executor when diagnosing a mod conflict. Requires Parallel Worldgen.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.section_terrai: Generates and commits compatible terrain by section instead of writing each block individually. Requires terrain filling, noise slices, cell caches, and native aquifers. Unsupported chunks keep the compatible terrain fill path.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.flat_cache_opt: Skips allocating unused flat-cache grids in chunks without old terrain blending.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.region_scan_op: Scans old-terrain metadata in one region task, skipping chunks that do not exist on disk.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.biome_codec_ca: Reuses the biome encoding codec for the same registry instead of creating it for every chunk save.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.noise_slice_op: Batch the density samples on cell boundaries.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.cell_cache_opt: Compile density calculations used to fill each cell cache.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.cell_interpola: Fill interpolated cell arrays directly from their corner values.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.preliminary_su: Reuse a mutable sampling context when finding preliminary terrain heights.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.density_wrappe: Reuse wrapped density functions within a noise chunk.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.density_spline: Reuse unchanged spline branches when mapping density functions.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_contex: Reuse compatible surface contexts and their bound rule instances between chunks.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_span_o: Skip runs of blocks with a certified common surface result. Requires buffered columns and rule evaluation.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_biome_: Cache biome lookups while applying surface rules.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.surface_band_n: Reuse exact noise samples for surface conditions and terracotta bands.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.aquifer_status: Share computed fluid statuses between native aquifer batches.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.native_blended: Sample blended terrain noise in native batches. Requires noise slice sampling.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.native_surface: Use native noise grids for surface depth and compiled surface rules.
tooltip.adrenaline.config.inline_generat: Run vanilla biome and noise tasks on the worker already executing their stage.
